Rashi on Menachot 23a:11:1.hebrew: עצם אי פריש - כגון פוקעין, לאו מצוה לאהדורי בפרק גיד הנשה (חולין צ.), הלכך לאו כעולין דמו. לשון אחר: קומץ שמיצה שמנו על גבי עצים, מהו? מי בעיא להקטיר עצים עם קומץ או לא? חבורי עולין — שמן שמחבר לקומץ — כעולין דמו, ואם אינו מקטירו הוי כקומץ חסר; או לא כעולין, ולא איכפת לן:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:11:1.english: A bone, if it separated - Such as [bones] that pop off [the altar fire], which it is not a mitzvah to return, [as stated] in the chapter [entitled] Gid HaNasheh (Chullin 90a); therefore, they are not considered like items that ascend [upon the altar]. Another explanation: [Regarding the dilemma:] A handful that discharged its oil onto pieces of wood, what is [the halakha]? Is one required to burn the wood along with the handful, or not? [Do we say that] attachments to items that ascend [upon the altar] — [namely,] the oil that connects [the wood] to the handful — are considered like items that ascend, and if he does not burn it [the wood], it is considered like a deficient handful; or [are they] not considered like items that ascend, and we do not care [if it is not burned]?

Rashi on Menachot 23a:12:1.hebrew: שתי מנחות כו' - כבר פירשתי למעלה (דף כב.):
Rashi on Menachot 23a:12:1.english: Two meal offerings, etc. - I have already explained [this] above (page 22a).

Rashi on Menachot 23a:15:1.hebrew: נבילה בטלה בשחוטה - אם יש שתי חתיכות (אחת) שחוטה ואחת נבילה, ואין ידוע איזוהי, בטלה בהן, שאם נגע באחת מחתיכות אינו טמא, דאמרינן שחוטה היא:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:15:1.english: A carcass is nullified in slaughtered [meat] - If there are two pieces (one) of slaughtered [meat] and one of a carcass, and it is not known which one it is, it is nullified among them, such that if one touches one of the pieces, he is not ritually impure, for we say that it is the slaughtered [one].

Rashi on Menachot 23a:15:2.hebrew: שאי אפשר לשחוטה שתעשה נבילה - והוה ליה מין בשאינו מינו, ובטל לדברי הכל:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:15:2.english: Because it is impossible for slaughtered [meat] to become a carcass - And it is [therefore considered a mixture of] different kinds, and is nullified according to everyone.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:16:1.hebrew: ושחוטה אינה בטילה בנבילה - אם יש שתי חתיכות נבילה ואחת שחוטה ביניהן, אינה בטילה. ואם נגעה אחת מהן בתרומה, אינה נשרפת עליה, אלא תולין, דשמא זו היא השחוטה:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:16:1.english: And a slaughtered [animal] is not nullified in a carcass - If there are two pieces of carcass and one slaughtered [piece] among them, [the slaughtered piece] is not nullified. And if one of them touched teruma, [the teruma] is not burned on its account; rather, [its status] is held in suspense, as perhaps this is the slaughtered [piece].

Rashi on Menachot 23a:16:2.hebrew: שאפשר לנבילה שתיעשה שחוטה - לקמיה מפרש טעמא דרב חסדא דאזיל בתר מבטל, והואיל ואי אפשר לרוב להיות כמועט, הוי כמין בשאינו מינו, ולא אזלינן בתר בטיל, דאף על גב דאפשר למועט להיות כמרובה, הוי כמין בשאינו מינו:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:16:2.english: As it is possible for a carcass to become [like] a slaughtered [animal] - Later, [the Gemara] explains Rav Chisda's reasoning, that he follows the nullifying [substance]: and since it is impossible for the majority to become like the minority, it is [considered] like a different kind; and we do not follow the nullified [substance], for even though it is possible for the minority to become like the majority, it is [nevertheless considered] like a different kind.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:16:3.hebrew: פרחה טומאה - דכתיב (דברים י״ד:כ״א) לגר אשר בשעריך תתננה, ואמרינן בבכורות (דף כג:) הראויה לגר קרויה נבילה:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:16:3.english: The impurity departs - For it is written (Deuteronomy 14:21): "To the stranger who is within your gates you may give it," and we say in Bekhorot (page 23b): "That which is fit for a stranger is called a carcass."

Rashi on Menachot 23a:17:1.hebrew: כל שאפשר לו - לבטל, דהיינו מועט, להיות כמוהו של מבטל, אינו בטל. הלכך, נבילה אינה בטילה בשחוטה, אבל שחוטה בטילה בנבילה, דאי אפשר לשחוטה שתיעשה נבילה. ואם נגעה אחת מן החתיכות בתרומה, נשרפת עליה, דרבי חנינא אזיל בתר בטיל:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:17:1.english: Whatever it is possible for it - [Meaning, for] the item being nullified, that is, the minority, to become like it, [namely, like that] of the nullifier, is not nullified. Therefore, [meat of a] carcass is not nullified in slaughtered [meat], but slaughtered [meat] is nullified in [meat of a] carcass, since it is impossible for slaughtered [meat] to become a carcass. And if one of the pieces touched teruma, [the teruma] is burned on account of it, for Rabbi Ḥanina follows [the status of] the nullified [item].

Rashi on Menachot 23a:18:1.english: Behold, a substance [mixed] with its own kind is nullified - Therefore, whether [it is] carcass [meat] in slaughtered [meat] or slaughtered [meat] in carcass [meat], they are [both] nullified.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:1:1.english: A kind with its kind - [This refers to] oil and oil.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:1:2.english: And another explanation - [This refers to] fine flour.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:1:3.hebrew: סלק את מינו - שמן דקמץ משום נדבה כמי שאינו, ונמצא סולתו של קומץ רבה על שמן הנבלע בו ומבטלה:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:1:3.english: Remove its kind - The oil of the handful [taken] as a voluntary offering [is considered] as if it does not exist, and the flour of the handful is found to be greater than the oil absorbed in it, and nullifies it.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:2:1.english: That he oiled it - That he put oil on it after he took the handful.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:2:2.hebrew: הוא עצמו - כלומר, תחילת מצוה שישפשפנו לקומץ בשירי מנחה, אחד מן הלוגין, וכל שכן דאם שמנו כשר:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:2:2.english: It itself - That is to say, [it is] the mitzvah at the outset that he should rub the handful in the remnants of [the oil of] a meal offering, [from] one of the logs, and all the more so, that if he oiled it, it is fit.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:3:1.hebrew: שלא יקבע לה שמן - בעוד שלא נקמצה, אבל לאחר קמיצה, אם שמנה קצת, כשר:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:3:1.english: That one should not designate oil for it - [This applies] while its handful has not yet been removed; but after the removal of the handful, if one oiled it a little, it is valid.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:4:1.hebrew: יקריב - דרבנן לטעמייהו, דעולין אין מבטלין זה את זה:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:4:1.english: He shall sacrifice [it] - For the Rabbis [follow] their reasoning, that items that ascend [the altar] do not nullify one another.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:4:2.hebrew: רבי יהודה אומר לא יקריב - ואפי' רבנן לא אמרי יקרב אלא משום דעולין אין מבטלין זה את זה, והיכא דאיתיה אמנחת נדבה שדינן ליה, אבל אם נפל שמן בקומץ דחוטא, אפילו לרבנן לא יקרב:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:4:2.english: Rabbi Yehuda says: He shall not sacrifice [it] - And even the Rabbis say that it shall be sacrificed only because items that ascend [the altar] do not nullify one another, and wherever it [the oil] is, we attribute it to the voluntary meal offering; but if oil fell into the handful of a sinner's [meal offering], even according to the Rabbis it shall not be sacrificed.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:5:1.hebrew: מנחת נסכים של פרים ואילים - חריבה לגבי מנחת נסכים כבש, דכבש הוי שלשה לוגין לעשרון, דכתיב בפרשת שלח לך: סלת עשרון בלול ברביעית ההין שמן, והין שנים עשר לוגין; ושל פרים ואילים – שני לוגין לעשרון, דכתיב בפר: בלול בשמן חצי ההין, דהיינו ששה לוגין, ושלשה עשרונים סלת; ובאילים: סלת שתי עשרונים בלול בשמן שלישית ההין. והיכא דנתערבה מנחת פרים במנחת כבשים – התם ודאי לא יקרב, משום דנמצאת העבה רכה; אבל קומץ דמנחת חוטא דאיערב בקומץ דמנחת נדבה – יקרב:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:5:1.english: The libation meal offering of bulls and rams - It is [considered] dry relative to the libation meal offering of a lamb, for [the offering of] a lamb has three log [of oil] per tenth [of an ephah of flour], as it is written in parashat Shelach Lekha: "A tenth [of an ephah of] fine flour mixed with a fourth of a hin of oil" (Numbers 15:4), and a hin is twelve log [so a fourth of a hin is three log]; whereas that of bulls and rams has two log per tenth [of an ephah], as it is written regarding a bull: "Mixed with oil, half a hin" (Numbers 15:9)—which is six log—and "three tenths [of an ephah of] fine flour" [which equals two log per tenth]; and regarding rams: "Fine flour, two tenths [of an ephah], mixed with oil, a third of a hin" (Numbers 15:6) [which is four log for two tenths, also two log per tenth]. And where the meal offering of bulls was intermingled with the meal offering of sheep, there [according to Rabbi Yehuda] it certainly may not be offered, because the thick [offering] becomes soft; but a handful of a sinner's meal offering that was intermingled with a handful of a voluntary meal offering may be offered.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:6:1.english: Rabbi Yehuda says: It shall not be sacrificed - For that which is not of its kind exceeds it and nullifies it.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:6:2.hebrew: פרושי קמפרש - והכי קאמר: מנחת פרים בשל כבשים, דהיינו חרב שנתערב בבלול, דבלועין זה מזה, אפי' הכי לרבנן יקרב, דאין עולין מבטלין זה את זה:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:6:2.english: It is explaining - And this is what [the baraita] is saying: [In the case of] a meal offering of bulls [mixed] with that of sheep, which is [an instance of] a dry [offering] that was mixed with a mixed [one], where they absorb from one another, even so, according to the Rabbis, it shall be sacrificed, for items that ascend [the altar] do not nullify one another.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:7:1.english: Upon the wood - And he placed the handful upon it.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:7:2.hebrew: מהו - מי הוי חסר קומץ, או לא? מי אמרינן: חבורי עולין — מה שהוא מחבר השמן לקומץ, שחוזר ונותן הקומץ על העצים:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:7:2.english: What is [the halakha] - Is it [considered] a deficient handful, or not? Do we say [that] adjuncts of offerings that ascend — [namely,] that which connects the oil to the handful, in that he goes back and places the handful on the wood — [are considered like offerings that ascend]?

Rashi on Menachot 23a:7:3.hebrew: כעולין דמו - כאילו הוי השמן מובלע בקומץ וכשר, או לאו כעולין ופסול:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:7:3.english: Are considered as [items that] ascend - As if the oil is absorbed in the handful and it is valid, or [is it] not [considered] as [items that] ascend, and it is invalid.

Rashi on Menachot 23a:8:1.english: One who offers up - Outside [the Temple courtyard].

Rashi on Menachot 23a:9:1.hebrew: עולין - בשר. חבורי עולין - עצם. שמן לאו מין סלת היא:
Rashi on Menachot 23a:9:1.english: Items that ascend - [This refers to the] meat. "Attachments to items that ascend" [refers to the] bone. [And regarding the Gemara's statement that oil is not of the same kind as the handful: this is because] oil is not of the species of fine flour.

Tosafot on Menachot 23a:15:1.hebrew: נבילה בטילה בשחוטה - היינו מלטמא במגע, אבל במשא מטמא, כדאמרי' בפרק שלישי דבכורות (דף כג.):
Tosafot on Menachot 23a:15:1.english: An animal carcass is nullified in a slaughtered [animal] - That is, [it is nullified only] from imparting impurity through contact, but through carrying it imparts impurity, as we say in the third chapter of Bekhorot (23a).

Tosafot on Menachot 23a:16:1.hebrew: שחוטה אינה בטילה בנבילה - והיכא דקבעי ברשות הרבים, ואינו יודע באיזו מהן נגע, ספיקו טהור, דכל קבוע כמחצה על מחצה דמי, היכא דאפשר למיהוי כוותיה. ודם הפר ודם השעיר, כיון שהיה מעורב בו כאחת ונתן מהן מתנה, חשיב דאפשר להיות זה כזה:
Tosafot on Menachot 23a:16:1.english: [Meat of] a slaughtered animal is not nullified in a carcass - And where they are fixed in the public domain and one does not know which of them he touched, his doubt is [ruled] pure, for anything that is fixed is considered like half and half, where it is possible [for one] to become like it. And [as for] the blood of the bull and the blood of the goat, since they were mixed together as one and he placed an application [on the altar] from them, it is considered that it is possible to be this like that.

Tosafot on Menachot 23a:1:1.hebrew: אמר רבא קסבר רבי יהודה כו' - הא דאמר בפ' כל הבשר (חולין קח.) בשמעתא דטיפת חלב, דאמר רבא קסבר רבי יהודה כל שהוא מין ומינו כו', היינו הכא בשמעתין, שהוא עיקר מילתיה דרבא; ולא כמו שפי' שם בקונטרס, דהיינו רבא דפרק גיד הנשה (חולין ק: ושם), שאמר אפילו לא קדם וסלקו הוי מין ומינו ודבר אחר כו', דהתם לא קאמר בהאי לישנא קסבר רבי יהודה כו':
Tosafot on Menachot 23a:1:1.english: Rava said: Rabbi Yehuda holds, etc. - That which [the Gemara] says in chapter Kol HaBasar (Chullin 108a), in the sugya of the drop of milk, that Rava said: "Rabbi Yehuda holds [that in] whatever is [a mixture of] like with like, etc." — this refers to here in our sugya, which is the primary source of Rava's statement; and not as the Kuntres [Rashi] explained there, that this refers to Rava of chapter Gid HaNasheh (Chullin 100b and there), who said: "Even if one did not precede and remove it, it is [a case of] like with like and another substance, etc.," for there he did not say in this phrasing: "Rabbi Yehuda holds, etc."

Tosafot on Menachot 23a:2:1.hebrew: הוא עצמו משכשכו בשירי הלוג - פירוש: לוג של מנחות שניתותר. וא"ת: הא תנן בפירקין (דף כז.), השמן מיעוטו מעכב את רובו? וי"ל, שלא ניתנה תורה למלאכי השרת, ואי אפשר שלא ישאר בלוג מן השמן:
Tosafot on Menachot 23a:2:1.english: He himself swishes it in the residue of the log - Explanation: A log [of oil] of meal-offerings that remained over. And if you say: But didn't we learn in our chapter (27a): "The oil, a minority of it prevents [the validity of] the majority of it"? And one can say that the Torah was not given to the ministering angels, and it is impossible that [some] of the oil would not remain in the log.

Tosafot on Menachot 23a:4:1.hebrew: הרב שנתערב בבלול כו' - יש תימה: מאי קא פריך? דלעולם מודה רבי שמעון בן לקיש דאם היו עולין מבטלין, ואפי' לרבנן לא יקרב, ולא משום חרב שנשתמן, אלא משום בלול שנחסר, דהוה ליה חיסר שמנה, דהא נתערב שמנו בחרב ובטל, וה"ל ככשר ופסול שנתערבו זה בזה. וצריך עיון אם הוה אמרינן יקרב אם לאו. וי"ל דלא חשיב חיסר שמנה, דאע"ג דמספקינ' ליה לרבא בסמוך גבי קומץ שמיצה שמנו על גבי עצים אי חיבורי עולין כעולין, הכא פשיטא דכעולין דמיא כשמיצה שמנו בחרב, כיון דשניהן נקטרים. ולפי זה, לא מיפסלו לעולם משום חיסר שמנה, אלא משום ריבה שמנה:
Tosafot on Menachot 23a:4:1.english: A dry [offering] that was intermingled with [one] mixed [with oil], etc. - There is a difficulty: What is [Rabbi Yoḥanan's] objection? For actually, Rabbi Shimon ben Lakish could concede that if items that ascend [the altar] nullify [one another], then even according to the Rabbis it would not be offered — and not because the dry [offering] became oiled, but rather because the mixed [offering] became deficient, as it becomes [an offering that is] lacking its oil, for its oil became intermingled with the dry [offering] and was nullified, and [thus] it is like a fit [offering] and an unfit [offering] that became intermingled with each other. And it requires investigation whether we would say [in such a case] that it should be offered or not. And one can say that it is not considered [an offering that is] lacking its oil, for even though it is a dilemma to Rava nearby (below, 23a) regarding a handful whose oil squeezed out onto the wood, whether items contiguous to items that ascend [the altar] are considered like items that ascend [the altar], here it is obvious that it is considered like items that ascend [the altar] when its oil squeezed out into the dry [offering], since both of them are burned [on the altar]. And according to this, they are never invalidated on account of lacking its oil, but rather on account of increasing its oil.

Tosafot on Menachot 23a:7:1.hebrew: קומץ שמיצה שמנו ע"ג עצים - פי' קצת נבלע מן השמן בעצים, ומקצתו בעין על גבי עצים עם הקומץ; ומבעיא ליה: איחשיב הנבלע כאילו הוא בעין ע"ג עצים, הואיל ומחובר למה שבחוץ מחמת דחיבורי עולין כעולין דמו, או לא? ובקונט' פירש ב' לשונות, וכמו שפירש' נראה:
Tosafot on Menachot 23a:7:1.english: A handful whose oil [the priest] squeezed onto the wood - [The] explanation [is that] some of the oil was absorbed into the wood, and some of it [remained] in substance on top of the wood together with the handful; and [Rava] raises the dilemma: Is the absorbed [oil] considered as though it were in substance on top of the wood—since it is connected to that which is outside [on the surface], by virtue of [the principle that] connected parts of offerings are considered like offerings (chiburei olin ke-olin damu)—or not? And in the Kunteres [Rashi], he explained two interpretations; and it appears as we have explained.
